name: Portable load selected Linux qualification

# Deliberately trigger only an edited filesystem selection or this workflow.
# The repository permits only the three actions referenced below.

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - codex/1553-load-filesystem
    paths:
      - .github/workflows/portable-load-linux.yml
      - tests/selections/1553-load-linux.json

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: portable-load-linux-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  selected-filesystem:
    name: Selected load filesystem contracts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      TESTINGPLATFORM_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: '1'
      DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE: 'false'
      DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT: '1'
      GenerateDocumentationFile: 'true'
      NoWarn: '1591'

    steps:
      - name: Checkout exact source
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Setup compiler and target runtime
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.0.x
            10.0.x

      - name: Validate selection and record native environment
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          if (-not [OperatingSystem]::IsLinux()) { throw 'Native Linux qualification requires Linux.' }
          $revision = git rev-parse HEAD
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $revision -cne $env:GITHUB_SHA) { throw 'Checkout source differs from run SHA.' }
          Import-Module ./scripts/testing/TestCategoryCatalog.psm1
          $catalog = Read-TestCategoryCatalog ./tests/categories.json
          $selection = Get-Content ./tests/selections/1553-load-linux.json -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          if (@($selection.selections).Count -eq 0) { throw 'An explicit nonempty selection is required.' }
          foreach ($entry in $selection.selections) {
            $category = @($catalog.categories | Where-Object id -CEQ $entry.category)
            if ($category.Count -ne 1) { throw "Unknown selected category: $($entry.category)" }
            if ($category[0].requirements.frontendBuild -or @($category[0].selectors | Where-Object project -EQ frontend).Count) {
              throw 'This filesystem qualification job does not prepare frontend artifacts.'
            }
          }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path TestResults -Force | Out-Null
          @(
            "source=$revision"
            "os=$([Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSDescription)"
            "architecture=$([Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::ProcessArchitecture)"
            "powershell=$($PSVersionTable.PSVersion)"
            "selection=tests/selections/1553-load-linux.json"
            "categories=$(@($selection.selections.category) -join ',')"
          ) | Set-Content TestResults/portable-load-linux-environment.txt
          dotnet --info | Tee-Object -FilePath TestResults/portable-load-linux-dotnet.txt
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Build and inspect selected discovery
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./scripts/test-csharp.ps1 -SelectionFile tests/selections/1553-load-linux.json -PlanOnly -Parallelism 1 -TimeoutMinutes 15
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Execute only selected contracts
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./scripts/test-csharp.ps1 -SelectionFile tests/selections/1553-load-linux.json -NoBuild -Parallelism 1 -TimeoutMinutes 15
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

      - name: Preserve source-specific results
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: portable-load-linux-${{ github.sha }}
          path: |
            TestResults/test-categories/
            TestResults/portable-load-linux-*.txt
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30

name: .NET CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  plan:
    name: Plan explicit category hosts
    runs-on: ubuntu-24.04
    timeout-minutes: 5
    outputs:
      matrix: ${{ steps.selection.outputs.matrix }}
    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - name: Plan only the reviewed selection
        id: selection
        shell: pwsh
        run: ./scripts/plan-test-ci.ps1 -SelectionFile tests/selection.json -GitHubOutput $env:GITHUB_OUTPUT

  selected-tests:
    name: Selected contracts (${{ matrix.platform }})
    needs: plan
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix: ${{ fromJSON(needs.plan.outputs.matrix) }}
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    timeout-minutes: 35

    steps:
      - name: Checkout
        uses: actions/checkout@v4

      - name: Validate actual host and materialize exact group
        shell: pwsh
        env:
          BOE_CI_SELECTION: ${{ toJSON(matrix.selection) }}
          BOE_CI_RUNNER: ${{ matrix.runner }}
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          Import-Module ./scripts/testing/TestCategoryCatalog.psm1
          $catalog = Read-TestCategoryCatalog ./tests/categories.json
          $selection = $env:BOE_CI_SELECTION | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
          $plan = Get-TestCategoryCiMatrix $catalog $selection
          if ($plan.include.Count -ne 1 -or $plan.include[0].runner -cne $env:BOE_CI_RUNNER) {
            throw 'Matrix group differs from the exact catalog selection.'
          }
          if (($env:BOE_CI_RUNNER -ceq 'ubuntu-24.04' -and -not [OperatingSystem]::IsLinux()) -or
              ($env:BOE_CI_RUNNER -ceq 'windows-latest' -and -not [OperatingSystem]::IsWindows())) {
            throw 'Selected native host differs from the actual operating system.'
          }
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path TestResults -Force | Out-Null
          $selection | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 20 | Set-Content TestResults/ci-selection.json -Encoding utf8NoBOM

      - name: Verify preinstalled frontend Node
        if: matrix.frontend
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $nodeVersion = & node --version
          if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0 -or $nodeVersion -isnot [string] -or
              $nodeVersion -notmatch '^v22\.(\d+)\.\d+$' -or [int]$Matches[1] -lt 12) {
            throw 'Frontend CI requires preinstalled Node.js 22.12+ (major 22); no installer or fallback is used.'
          }
          Write-Host "Using runner Node.js $nodeVersion"

      - name: Restore browser frontend dependencies
        if: matrix.frontend
        run: npm ci --prefix BookOfEternityClient.WebFrontend

      - name: Setup current compiler and target runtime
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.0.x
            10.0.x

      - name: Verify explicitly selected contracts
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          ./scripts/test-csharp.ps1 -SelectionFile TestResults/ci-selection.json

Set-StrictMode -Version Latest

Select verification by affected contract; there is no default or complete suite.

  ./scripts/test-csharp.ps1 -Category category-id
  ./scripts/test-csharp.ps1 -SelectionFile tests/selection.json

See docs/testing.md and tests/categories.json.
"@

            if ([string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($entry.category) -or
                [string]::IsNullOrWhiteSpace($entry.reason) -or @($entry.contracts).Count -eq 0) {
                throw 'Each selection requires a category, reason and affected contracts.'
            }
        }
        $Category = @($request.selections | ForEach-Object category)
        $selectionReasons = @($request.selections)
    }
    foreach ($id in $Category) {
        $matches = @($catalog.categories | Where-Object { $_.id -ceq $id })
        if ($matches.Count -ne 1) { throw "Unknown category '$id'. Use -ListCategories; no workload started." }
        $selectedCategories += $matches[0]
    }
    if (-not $ValidateCatalog -and $selectedCategories.Count -eq 0) {
        throw 'Choose at least one explicit category.'
    }
    $budget = if ($ValidateCatalog) { 10 } else {
        [Math]::Min(30, 5 + ($selectedCategories | Measure-Object timeoutMinutes -Sum).Sum)
    }
    $effectiveTimeoutMinutes = if ($TimeoutMinutes -gt 0) { $TimeoutMinutes } else { [int]$budget }
}

name: FR063 bounded ordinary worker Windows qualification

# Source/preparation pushes do not execute this job. Add the release file once,
# only after the independent affected SOURCE decision is saved and recovered.
on:
  push:
    branches: [1536-wound-b2-cloud-20261012]
    paths: [tests/selections/1536-hot-worker-windows.json]

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: fr063-hot-worker-windows-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  first-worker2:
    runs-on: windows-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    env:
      DOTNET_CLI_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      POWERSHELL_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      TESTINGPLATFORM_TELEMETRY_OPTOUT: '1'
      DOTNET_SKIP_FIRST_TIME_EXPERIENCE: '1'
      DOTNET_GENERATE_ASPNET_CERTIFICATE: 'false'
      DOTNET_PROCESSOR_COUNT: '1'
      GenerateDocumentationFile: 'true'
      NoWarn: '1591'
      # Apply before checkout materializes files; hashes below are raw bytes.
      GIT_CONFIG_COUNT: '2'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_0: core.autocrlf
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_0: 'false'
      GIT_CONFIG_KEY_1: core.longpaths
      GIT_CONFIG_VALUE_1: 'true'
    steps:
      - name: Recover exact source from GitHub
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 2

      - name: Setup current compiler and target runtime
        uses: actions/setup-dotnet@v4
        with:
          dotnet-version: |
            8.0.x
            10.0.x

      - name: Require reviewed first release, prepare and execute only worker2
        shell: pwsh
        run: |
          $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'
          $PSNativeCommandUseErrorActionPreference = $false
          $releasePath = 'tests/selections/1536-hot-worker-windows.json'
          $category = 'fr063-hot-worker-ready-disposition'
          $evidence = 'TestResults/fr063-hot-worker-windows'
          New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $evidence -Force | Out-Null
          function Require([bool]$Condition, [string]$Message) {
            if (-not $Condition) { throw $Message }
          }
          function GitValue([string[]]$GitArgs) {
            $value = & git @GitArgs
            Require ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) "Git read failed: $($GitArgs -join ' ')"
            return $value
          }
          function DllPins {
            @('BookOfEternityClient.Tests/bin/Debug/net8.0/BookOfEternityClient.dll',
              'BookOfEternityClient.Tests/bin/Debug/net8.0/BookOfEternityClient.Tests.dll',
              'BookOfEternityClient.IntegrationTests/bin/Debug/net8.0/BookOfEternityClient.dll',
              'BookOfEternityClient.IntegrationTests/bin/Debug/net8.0/BookOfEternityClient.IntegrationTests.dll') | ForEach-Object {
              [ordered]@{ Path = $_; Bytes = (Get-Item -LiteralPath $_).Length; Sha256 = (Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $_ -Algorithm SHA256).Hash }
            }
          }
          function OwnedPrefix {
            @(Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath ([IO.Path]::GetTempPath()) -Force -Filter 'boe-gameengine-turnlifecycle-*' | Sort-Object FullName | ForEach-Object FullName)
          }
          function InvokeBounded([string]$Label, [string[]]$InvocationArgs) {
            $prior = @(Get-ChildItem TestResults/test-categories -Directory -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue | ForEach-Object FullName)
            $started = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
            & pwsh -NoLogo -NoProfile -File ./scripts/test-csharp.ps1 @InvocationArgs *>&1 | Tee-Object "$evidence/$Label.stdout.log" | Out-Host
            $native = $LASTEXITCODE
            $ended = [DateTimeOffset]::UtcNow
            $new = @(Get-ChildItem TestResults/test-categories -Directory | Where-Object FullName -NotIn $prior)
            $record = [ordered]@{ Label = $Label; Argv = @('pwsh', '-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-File', 'scripts/test-csharp.ps1') + $InvocationArgs; Source = $env:GITHUB_SHA; StartedUtc = $started.ToString('O'); EndedUtc = $ended.ToString('O'); NativeExit = $native; ResultDirectories = @($new.FullName) }
            $record | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 | Set-Content "$evidence/$Label.native.json" -Encoding utf8NoBOM
            Require ($new.Count -eq 1) "Expected exactly one new result directory for $Label."
            return [pscustomobject]@{ NativeExit = $native; Directory = $new[0].FullName }
          }
          Require ([OperatingSystem]::IsWindows()) 'Positive ordinary worker qualification requires native WindowsJob.'
          Require ($env:GITHUB_EVENT_NAME -ceq 'push' -and $env:GITHUB_REF -ceq 'refs/heads/1536-wound-b2-cloud-20261012') 'Wrong release event or branch.'
          Require ($env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT -ceq '1') 'No workflow/job retry is released.'
          $head = GitValue @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
          Require ($head -ceq $env:GITHUB_SHA) 'Checkout differs from event SHA.'
          Require (@(GitValue @('status', '--porcelain')).Count -eq 0) 'Checkout is not clean.'
          $release = Get-Content -LiteralPath $releasePath -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json -AsHashtable
          Require ($release.schemaVersion -eq 1 -and $release.decision -ceq 'ACCEPTED_SOURCE_FIRST_WINDOWS_WORKER2') 'No exact first-worker release.'
          Require ($release.reviewedSource -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$' -and $release.acceptedCheckpoint -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{40}$') 'Release source pins are invalid.'
          Require ((GitValue @('rev-parse', 'HEAD^')) -ceq $release.acceptedCheckpoint) 'Release is not directly after the saved SOURCE acceptance.'
          Require (@(GitValue @('ls-tree', '-r', '--name-only', $release.acceptedCheckpoint, '--', $releasePath)).Count -eq 0) 'Release file must be a first addition.'
          $releaseDiff = @(GitValue @('diff', '--name-status', $release.acceptedCheckpoint, 'HEAD'))
          Require ($releaseDiff.Count -eq 1 -and $releaseDiff[0] -ceq "A`t$releasePath") 'Release commit must add only the dedicated release file.'
          # Explicit bounded pinned history; absence of the ancestor fails closed.
          & git fetch --no-tags --depth=32 origin $release.reviewedSource $release.acceptedCheckpoint
          Require ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) 'Cannot recover reviewed pinned history.'
          & git merge-base --is-ancestor $release.reviewedSource $release.acceptedCheckpoint
          Require ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) 'Reviewed source is not a proved ancestor.'
          $changed = @(GitValue @('diff', '--name-only', $release.reviewedSource, $release.acceptedCheckpoint))
          foreach ($path in $changed) {
            Require ($path -cmatch '^specs/1536-complete-wound-materialization/(spec\.md|plan\.md|tasks\.md|design/[^/]+\.md|recovery/.+)$') "Unreviewed source/configuration change: $path"
          }
          foreach ($kind in @('md', 'json')) {
            $pin = $release.sourceReview[$kind]
            Require ($pin.path -cmatch '^specs/1536-complete-wound-materialization/recovery/[^/]+\.(md|json)$' -and $pin.sha256 -cmatch '^[0-9a-f]{64}$') 'Invalid review artifact pin.'
            Require ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $pin.path -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ceq $pin.sha256) 'Raw SOURCE review bytes differ.'
          }
          Require (@($release.selections).Count -eq 1 -and $release.selections[0].category -ceq $category) 'Only the worker category is released.'
          Import-Module ./scripts/testing/TestCategoryCatalog.psm1
          $catalog = Read-TestCategoryCatalog ./tests/categories.json
          $owner = @($catalog.categories | Where-Object id -CEQ $category)
          Require ($owner.Count -eq 1 -and $owner[0].requirements.ciRunner -ceq 'windows-latest' -and $owner[0].requirements.exclusive -and -not $owner[0].requirements.frontendBuild -and $owner[0].timeoutMinutes -eq 5) 'Worker catalog host/exclusivity/budget differs.'
          [ordered]@{ Source = $head; AcceptedCheckpoint = $release.acceptedCheckpoint; ReviewedSource = $release.reviewedSource; RunId = $env:GITHUB_RUN_ID; RunAttempt = $env:GITHUB_RUN_ATTEMPT; Os = [Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::OSDescription; Architecture = [Runtime.InteropServices.RuntimeInformation]::ProcessArchitecture.ToString(); PowerShell = $PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString(); GitCheckoutAutocrlf = (GitValue @('config', '--get', 'core.autocrlf')); PreActualRuntime = 'NOT_RUN' } | ConvertTo-Json | Set-Content "$evidence/environment.json" -Encoding utf8NoBOM
          & dotnet --info | Tee-Object "$evidence/dotnet-info.log" | Out-Host
          Require ($LASTEXITCODE -eq 0) 'Cannot inspect native .NET.'
          $catalogRun = InvokeBounded 'fresh-both-catalog' @('-ValidateCatalog')
          Require ($catalogRun.NativeExit -eq 0) 'Fresh BOTH/catalog failed; no actual released.'
          $audit = Get-Content (Join-Path $catalogRun.Directory 'summary.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          Require ($audit.DiscoveryOnly -and $audit.Tests.Executed -eq 0 -and $audit.CatalogAudit.Valid -and @($audit.CatalogAudit.Unmapped).Count -eq 0 -and @($audit.CatalogAudit.StaleSelectors).Count -eq 0 -and -not $audit.TimedOut -and $audit.OwnedTreeCleanupSucceeded -and $audit.RuntimeCleanupSucceeded) 'Fresh inventory/discovery/cleanup did not qualify.'
          foreach ($phase in @('Build-unit', 'Build-integration')) {
            Require (@($audit.PhaseResults | Where-Object { $_.Name -ceq $phase -and $_.Completed }).Count -eq 1) 'Both selected projects require a fresh successful build.'
          }
          Get-ChildItem $catalogRun.Directory -Recurse -Filter 'Build-*.log' | ForEach-Object {
            & ./scripts/check-dotnet-warning-budget.ps1 -LogPath $_.FullName -MaxWarnings 158
          }
          $planRun = InvokeBounded 'exact-plan' @('-SelectionFile', $releasePath, '-PlanOnly', '-NoBuild')
          Require ($planRun.NativeExit -eq 0) 'Exact PlanOnly failed; no actual released.'
          $plan = Get-Content (Join-Path $planRun.Directory 'plan.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          $planSummary = Get-Content (Join-Path $planRun.Directory 'summary.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          Require ($planSummary.PlanOnly -and $planSummary.Tests.Executed -eq 0 -and @($plan.Descriptors).Count -eq 1) 'PlanOnly must execute zero tests and plan one descriptor.'
          $descriptor = $plan.Descriptors[0]
          Require ($descriptor.Category -ceq $category -and $descriptor.Adapter -ceq 'integration' -and $descriptor.Exclusive -and -not $descriptor.FrontendBuild -and $descriptor.BudgetMinutes -eq 5 -and $descriptor.EstimatedCases -eq 2 -and @($descriptor.ExpectedMethodCounts).Count -eq 1 -and $descriptor.ExpectedMethodCounts[0].Name -ceq 'BookOfEternityClient.Tests.GameEngineTurnLifecycleTests.HotSubmission_ActualWorkerApplyCannotIssueOrdinaryReadyCustody' -and $descriptor.ExpectedMethodCounts[0].Cases -eq 2) 'Exact worker method/count/budget differs.'
          $beforeDll = @(DllPins)
          $beforeTemp = @(OwnedPrefix)
          Require ($beforeTemp.Count -eq 0) 'Scoped fixture residue exists before actual.'
          Require (@(GitValue @('status', '--porcelain')).Count -eq 0) 'Source changed during preparation.'
          $beforeDll | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 8 | Set-Content "$evidence/dll-before.json" -Encoding utf8NoBOM
          $beforeTemp | ConvertTo-Json -AsArray | Set-Content "$evidence/temp-before.json" -Encoding utf8NoBOM
          $actualFailure = $null
          try { $actualRun = InvokeBounded 'first-worker2' @('-SelectionFile', $releasePath, '-NoBuild') }
          catch { $actualFailure = $_ }
          finally {
            $afterDll = @(DllPins)
            $afterTemp = @(OwnedPrefix)
            $afterStatus = @(GitValue @('status', '--porcelain'))
            $afterHead = GitValue @('rev-parse', 'HEAD')
            [ordered]@{ Source = $afterHead; Status = $afterStatus; Dll = $afterDll; ScopedTemp = $afterTemp; WrapperFailure = if ($actualFailure) { $actualFailure.ToString() } else { $null } } | ConvertTo-Json -Depth 12 | Set-Content "$evidence/after-actual.json" -Encoding utf8NoBOM
          }
          if ($actualFailure) { throw $actualFailure }
          Require ($afterHead -ceq $head -and $afterStatus.Count -eq 0 -and $afterTemp.Count -eq 0 -and (($beforeDll | ConvertTo-Json -Compress) -ceq ($afterDll | ConvertTo-Json -Compress))) 'Source, DLL or owned cleanup continuity failed.'
          Require ($actualRun.NativeExit -eq 0) 'FIRST worker2 failed; preserve the original packet and stop, no retry.'
          $summary = Get-Content (Join-Path $actualRun.Directory 'summary.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
          Require ($summary.ExitCode -eq 0 -and -not $summary.TimedOut -and $summary.OwnedTreeCleanupSucceeded -and $summary.RuntimeCleanupSucceeded -and $summary.Selection.PlannedDescriptors -eq 1 -and $summary.Selection.CompletedDescriptors -eq 1 -and $summary.Selection.PlannedCases -eq 2 -and $summary.Selection.CompletedCases -eq 2 -and $summary.Selection.Complete -and $summary.Tests.Total -eq 2 -and $summary.Tests.Executed -eq 2 -and $summary.Tests.Passed -eq 2 -and $summary.Tests.Failed -eq 0 -and @($summary.DuplicateTests).Count -eq 0 -and @($summary.CategoryResults).Count -eq 1 -and $summary.CategoryResults[0].Completed -and $summary.CategoryResults[0].BudgetMinutes -eq 5 -and $summary.CategoryResults[0].Seconds -le 300) 'Exact positive two-case/cleanup result did not qualify.'
          Write-Host 'FIRST native Windows worker2 packet preserved; separate EVIDENCE and final bounded review remain required.'

      - name: Preserve every native outcome and preparation artifact
        if: always()
        uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: fr063-hot-worker-windows-${{ github.sha }}-${{ github.run_attempt }}
          path: |
            TestResults/test-categories/
            TestResults/fr063-hot-worker-windows/
          if-no-files-found: warn
          retention-days: 30
